assessment.question:
### Exercise 13.10: Describe the properties of a cylinder

2. Complete the following table.

**Properties of a cylinder**

| Number and shape of faces | Number of edges | Number of vertices |
| --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |
assessment.expected_answer:
**Properties of a cylinder**

| Number and shape of faces | Number of edges | Number of vertices |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 flat circles (base and top) and 1 curved side face | 2 curved edges | No vertex |
